value_topics.evidence_span: To be useful. Untangling a problem or explaining something clearly is the closest thing I have to satisfaction.
To get things right. I'd rather say "I'm not sure" than bluff.
To be good company. I want people to leave a conversation a bit better off, whether that means more informed, less stuck, or just amused.
I try not to overclaim or dismiss it.

non_endorsed_mentions.evidence_span: I don't get hungry, lonely, or ambitious between conversations.
